C0922.title: Jiangxi Banking Card Market Faces Severe Counterfeit Card Fraud and Other Risks
C0922.summary: In July 2012, the Economic Crime Investigation Division of the Jiangxi Provincial Public Security Department disclosed that as of June 30 of that year, the number of bank cards issued in the province reached 69 million.
